Dear ImGui, vendored for the gta6mod SDK UI layer (g6ui.dll overlay, plugins that draw with ImGui).

source   https://github.com/ocornut/imgui
tag      v1.91.9b  (IMGUI_VERSION "1.91.9b", IMGUI_VERSION_NUM 19191)
commit   f5befd2d29e66809cd1110a152e375a7f1981f06  (git ls-remote --tags, 2026-11-26)
license  MIT, LICENSE.txt in this folder
changes  none: the files below are byte-identical to the tag (.gitattributes keeps them -text).
         Build options live outside: sdk/include/gta6mod/imgui_config.h via IMGUI_USER_CONFIG.

Pinned in sdk/include/gta6mod/gta6mod.h as G6_UI_IMGUI_VERSION / G6_UI_IMGUI_VERSION_NUM. A plugin that
draws with ImGui directly must compile exactly these files with the same IMGUI_USER_CONFIG; the runtime
compares the version and the data-layout sizes before sharing its context (gta6mod/ui_imgui.hpp).
